jobs.occupation: Technology Transfer & Partnership Manager – Applied Geodata & Research Solutions (Full-Time / m/f/d) (Master of Business Administration)
jobs.description: Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available) Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent / Dual Master Track available) Target Group: Business Development Managers, Technology Transfer Specialists, Marketing & Sales Talents, Master’s Graduates, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) Holders About Project Iris Project Iris is an applied research initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, land registry intelligence, sustainable infrastructure mapping, and open-source resilience modeling. Through this framework, proprietary data algorithms, geospatial scoring models, and automation tools are licensed and deployed across real-world commercial sectors (e.g., real estate, institutional investments, infrastructure providers, and SME enterprise solutions). Your Focus & Responsibilities - Research Transfer & Commercialization: Identify commercial use cases for our geospatial and resilience data models, translating scientific capabilities into clear value propositions for enterprise clients and institutional partners. - B2B Outreach & Pipeline Management: Lead proactive outreach campaigns targeting potential data partners, municipalities, enterprise clients, and specialized service providers using modern CRM and automation tools (e.g., Odoo ERP, automated email workflows). - Partner Onboarding & Account Management: Manage communication with corporate partners, coordinate pilot testing phases, and gather operational market feedback to help researchers refine underlying data models. - Marketing & Value Proposition Communication: Create structured presentation decks, use-case briefs, and digital campaign materials to position our data products in commercial and public markets. - Funding & Grant Alignment: Support the interface between commercial data licensing and applied research funding projects. What We Are Looking For - Educational Background: Degree in Business Administration, Technology Management, International Business, Marketing, Geoinformatics, Economics, or a related field. - Professional Competencies: - Strong interest in technology, spatial data, AI platforms, or digital business models. - Experience with or quick adoption of digital outreach tools, CRM systems (e.g., Odoo), and structured email communication. - High level of communication clarity, commercial acumen, and consultative relationship-building skills. - Mindset: Proactive, structured, and comfortable working at the intersection of non-profit research and commercial markets. - Eligibility: Open to local and international applicants currently in Germany (e.g., Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card, Job-Seeker Visa, EU Work Permit). - Languages: Excellent working proficiency in English (required); good command of German is a strong advantage for the DACH market. What We Offer - Full-Time Permanent Position: Long-term career security with direct exposure to executive management and commercial leadership. - Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: We support continuous academic development through fully sponsored Master Trainee and Dual Master tracks. - Accommodation & Onboarding Support: Concrete assistance with local housing search, official registration, and structured onboarding. - Visa & Relocation Assistance: Comprehensive employer backing for German Opportunity Card conversions and residence permit processes. - Direct Business Impact: Drive the commercial sustainability of high-impact research projects without corporate bureaucracy. How to Apply Send your CV, references, and your earliest possible start date to: E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.de  (Subject: Application – Technology Transfer & Partnership Manager)

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer – Applied AI, Geodata Systems & Data Transfer (Full-Time / m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)

Make Dubai your home and enjoy all the benefits of this vibrant city.If you’re ready for a career that takes you places, apply online now and start your adventure with EmiratesWE ARE LOOKING FOR:• At least 1 year of hospitality or customer service experience• Positive attitude with the natural ability to provide excellent service in a team environment, dealing with people from many cultures• A minimum of high school (Grade 12) education• Fluent in written and spoken English (additional languages are an advantage)• Arm reach of 212 cm while standing on tiptoes and minimum height of 160 cm which will enable you to reach emergency equipment on all aircraft types• No visible tattoos while you’re in Emirates cabin crew uniform (cosmetic and bandage coverings are not allowed)• Can adapt to new people, new places and new situations• As an Emirates cabin crew, you will be based in Dubai and will need to meet the UAE’s employment visa requirements• At least 21 years oldMORE INFORMATIONVisithttps://www.emiratesgroupcareers.com/cabin-crewfor details of our walk-in recruitment days and how to apply.Open dayWalk into any of our Open Days happening all over the world. jobs.occupation: Office Manager (m/f/d), Fishlabs GmbH (Office-Manager/in)
jobs.description: About Fishlabs Fishlabs GmbH, headquartered in Hamburg, has been delivering outstanding video games since 2004, consistently expanding its portfolio of shipped titles. In December 2013, the studio joined Plaion (formerly known as Koch Media), a world-leading developer, publisher, and distributor of digital entertainment products. As part of Plaion and alongside the various sister studios across the globe, FISHLABS keeps creating stunning immersive experiences that inspire millions of players worldwide. The 70-strong, multinational team of FISHLABS has assembled a broad portfolio of award-winning own IPs as well as co-development titles and keeps at the forefront of gaming.  We are looking to continue building on our success with humble but talented and creative people who have a passion for making outstanding games and want to be at the forefront of gaming. Are you ready for the challenge? Join us! This is going to be a thrilling ride. Your Mission Looking after the front office: You are the contact person for our colleagues and visitors Receiving and sending mail, general correspondence, as well as filing and office organization are part of your daily tasks Administration and ordering of office supplies (except IT hardware/software, which our IT department orders itself), merch items, drinks and food Checking incoming and outgoing invoices and being the contact person for suppliers Coordination with the property management (repairs and maintenance in the office) and external service providers such as cleaning services Organizing events (e.g. team events, Christmas parties, etc.) and travel planning. Looking after our company apartment (move-in and move-out dates, communication with the property management/cleaning service) Office onboarding for new employees We are looking for someone to work part-time in the mornings, on-site in our office, 5 days a week (~20 hours) Your Skillset Completed apprenticeship or equivalent professional experience At least 2-4 years of professional experience in office management A desire to work in an international environment Excellent command of German and English (English is the company language) Proficiency in standard office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) A proactive, independent, and structured approach to work, a hands-on mentality, enthusiasm, and a drive to move things forward Strong communication skills, openness to feedback, and self-confidence The ability to maintain an overview and a positive, friendly demeanor, even during hectic periods Flexibility in responding to various situations and the ability to spontaneously adjust priorities Strong organizational skills and the ability to work effectively, even under pressure Mission Support We are just as passionate about our games as we are about their creators (Could that be you?!). Your job comes with personal responsibility, freedom and short decision-making routes. And most importantly - A motivated, international team full of fellow gamers. The studio is located in a bright, modern office, right in the center of Hamburg. With a selection of benefits for all our staff: Including discounted gym membership, fresh fruit and a variety of free drinks. A healthy work-life balance is important to you? For us too! That's why we are also awarded as a family-friendly workplace. Coming from abroad? No problem! We also offer relocation packages. Get In Touch! Did we spark your interest? We are looking forward to your application. Simply click on the button below and apply by uploading your CV. If you have any further documents which you think might be worth sharing to underline your background and talents, we are happy to receive them as well. If you have questions regarding the application just drop us an e-mail at hr@fishlabs.de. An application via our online tool is preferred.
